map.zoomIn: Zooms the map in one step. The mouse wheel up or the + key do the same.
map.zoomOut: Zooms the map out one step. The mouse wheel down or the - key do the same.
map.fit: Shows the whole map, edge to edge.
map.me: Moves the map to where you are and zooms in on you.

places.text: Shows or hides service places like banks, stables and doctors. Only your view changes.

labels.text: Shows or hides town and area names on the map. Only your view changes.

map.refresh: Fetches the latest player positions and markers from the server now. They already update by themselves every second.
map.clearWaypoint: Removes the destination you set on your map. Nobody else is affected.
map.cursor: The coordinates of the spot under the mouse right now. Move the mouse over the map and they change.
map.legend: What the shapes mean: a circle is a player, a circle with a dot in it is you, a red diamond is a dead player and a small square is a service place.
map.following: The map follows the picked player as they move. It stops when you drag the map yourself.
map.tabPlayers: The players shown on the map. Press one and the map goes to them and their actions appear below.
map.tabPlaces: Towns, services and saved markers. Press one and the map goes there.
map.tabTools: Extra map tools: go to coordinates, and the look of the server map.
map.search: Filters the list by name, citizen ID like 12, session number like #5, or place name.
map.filterDead: Shows dead players only, to find fast who needs reviving.
map.colCitizen: The character's fixed citizen ID, with the session number (#) that changes each join under it.
map.colName: The character's name with their job under it.
map.colStatus: Whether the player is alive or dead right now.
map.colPlace: The place and its kind: town, service or saved marker.
map.selected: The player you picked. These actions apply to them, and their position updates every second.

follow.text: Keeps the map on the player as they move. Stops when you drag the map yourself.

map.position: Where the player is now, in numbers. Copy puts it as a vector3.
map.openPlayer: Opens the player's full file on the Players page, with money, items and moderation.
map.deselect: Clears the selection. Nothing happens to the player.

player.goto: Moves you to the player; the player does not move. The panel closes so you can see.

bring.text: Moves the player to you. Their old spot is saved so Send back can return them.

player.bringBack: Returns the player to where they were before you brought them. Works only after Bring.
player.revive: Brings the player back to life where they lie, with full health. The player notices right away.
player.heal: Fills the player's health. It does not bring back a dead player; use Revive.
player.refill: Fills the player's hunger and thirst to 100. They see it on their needs bar right away.

freeze.text: Holds the player in place until you unfreeze them. Useful while investigating or explaining.
freeze.undo: Yes, with the same button, Unfreeze

spectate.text: See the game from where the player is, to check what they are doing, while you stay hidden. Stop watching ends it and puts you back.

player.openInventory: Opens the player's bag on your screen to see and move their items. The menu closes to open the bag.
player.wardrobe: Opens the wardrobe on the player's own screen so they can change clothes.

map.findCoords: Type coordinates and the map goes there and marks the spot, so you can look before you jump. You can paste a whole vector3.
map.locate: Moves the map to the coordinates you typed and opens the spot's actions. It does not move you.

theme.text: Changes the colours of the server map for every player, not only you. It applies at once.

map.point: The spot you clicked on the map. Choose what to do with it.

waypoint.text: Sets a destination on this spot on your own map, like a player does in the game map.

copyPoint.text: Copies the spot as a vector2 to paste into a file or a message.

map.tpHere: Moves you to this spot, right onto the ground. The panel stays open.
map.bringHere: Moves the picked player to this spot. Their old spot is not saved, so be sure before you press.

map.noCfg: The map has not arrived yet. Make sure the map script w_map is running, then press Refresh.
map.pickHint: Pick a player in the list or press them on the map to see their actions here.
